# PDF Accessibility Tag Checker

> Free tool: drop a PDF in your browser and get an evidence report on tagging, title, language, image alt text, and form-field labels -- the structural checks behind PDF/UA and Section 508. The file never leaves your device. Also a zero-dependency CLI for batch-scanning a whole document library.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
